This folder contains the Polyp-PVT model definition from the authors' official repository:
https://github.com/DengPingFan/Polyp-PVT

The upstream repository states that its source code is free for research and education use only;
commercial use requires formal permission. The local change only makes its backbone initialization
optional and uses a package-relative import so a complete trained checkpoint can be loaded.

Paper: Dong et al., "Polyp-PVT: Polyp Segmentation with Pyramid Vision Transformers," 2023.
